description: This file implements the Timer class, which manages a timer thread with start, cancel, and callback functionalities. It includes thread synchronization, message handling, and timer expiry logic.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class that manages a timer thread, allowing arming, cancelling, and executing a callback upon expiry.

methods.name: timerThreadFunction
methods.description: Static function that runs in the timer thread, invoking the instance method.

methods.name: Timer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes synchronization primitives and starts the timer thread.

methods.name: ~Timer
methods.description: Destructor that posts a quit message, joins the thread, and cleans up synchronization primitives.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels any active timer, preventing the callback from being called.

methods.name: arm
methods.description: Arms the timer for a specified timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: timerThread
methods.description: Main loop of the timer thread, handling messages and timer expiry.

methods.name: postTimerMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to the timer thread's message queue.
